name: grey_qo
description: A contemporary calligraphic script, Grey Qo combines traditional uppercase calligraphics with more stylized script lowercase forms. It comes with Latin Character sets including Western, Central, and Vietnamese language support. To contribute, see github.com/googlefonts/grey-qo .
